mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ecm_shipment ( order_id, carrier_cd, invoice_no, status_cd, recipient_nm, recipient_phone, zipcode, address, address_detail, box_cnt, weight_kg, request_payload, response_payload, issued_dt, reg_id, update_id ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{carrierCd}, #{invoiceNo}, #{statusCd}, #{recipientNm}, #{recipientPhone}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{boxCnt}, #{weightKg}, #{requestPayload}, #{responsePayload}, #{issuedDt}, #{regId}, #{updateId} )
mapper.select: SELECT shipment_id, order_id, carrier_cd, invoice_no, status_cd, recipient_nm, recipient_phone, zipcode, address, address_detail, box_cnt, weight_kg, request_payload, response_payload, issued_dt, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt FROM ecm_shipment WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId}

SELECT shipment_id, order_id, carrier_cd, invoice_no, status_cd, recipient_nm, recipient_phone, zipcode, address, address_detail, box_cnt, weight_kg, request_payload, response_payload, issued_dt, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt FROM ecm_shipment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY shipment_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecm_shipment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status_cd = 'ISSUED' AND invoice_no IS NOT NULL
